## Activity

East City Eye Clinic recorded 132 captures during March 2020. This level of activity provides the basis for reviewing the month’s image quality and grading outcomes. The recorded capture total should be considered alongside the number of images available for assessment and the results returned through the grading process. Any operational matters affecting capture activity should continue to be noted through the usual local reporting arrangements.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 3 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 2.3. The result indicates that most images were suitable for assessment, while a small proportion could not be used for grading. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be reviewed and addressed through the appropriate support process.

## Grading

There were 25 referable results during the month. The median grading wait was 1 days. The grading results and waiting time should be monitored with subsequent activity to identify any emerging operational concerns. Continued review of capture quality and grading performance will support consistent service delivery at East City Eye Clinic.
